```{r setup, include=F, message=F}

library(tidyverse)

fn_files <- list.files(path = file.path("Utils"), full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(fn_files, source))

Rcpp::sourceCpp("SFS-master/src/sampleSFS.cpp")
```

```{r, include = F}

sub_cols <- c("C > A" = "#4FA9DF", "C > G" = "#231F20", "C > T" = "#E43B34",
              "T > A" = "gray70", "T > C" = "#8CC63F", "T > G" = "#EFA9CB")

bg_cols <- c("C > A" = "#D3E9F7", "C > G" = "#D9D9D9", "C > T" = "#F2C6C6",
             "T > A" = "#F7F7F7", "T > C" = "#E3EFD0", "T > G" = "#FAEBF3")

bg_cols_gray <- c("C > A" = "#F7F7F7", "C > G" = "#F7F7F7", "C > T" = "#F7F7F7",
             "T > A" = "#F7F7F7", "T > C" = "#F7F7F7", "T > G" = "#F7F7F7")

equal_breaks <- function(n = 3, s = 0.05, ...){
  function(x){
    d <- s * diff(range(x)) / (1 + 2 * s)
    seq(min(x) + d, max(x) - d, length = n)
  }
}

```

# Parameters

```{r}

seed <- 1:5
tol <- 1e-8
maxiter <- 1000
k <- 9
lambda_tilde <- 0.005
delta <- 1

params <- data.frame(
  seed = paste(seed, collapse = ", "),
  tol = format(tol, scientific = TRUE),
  maxiter = maxiter,
  k = k,
  lambda_tilde = lambda_tilde,
  delta = delta
)

knitr::kable(params, row.names = FALSE)

```


# Lung A. data

```{r}

obj_name <- load("Data/LACA24.Rdata")

V_raw <- get("V")

V <- as.matrix(V_raw[, order(colSums(V_raw)), drop = F])

```

## Fit

```{r}

fit <- KLNMF(V, k = k, seed = seed, tol = tol, maxiter = maxiter)

```

```{r, warning = F, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, fig.align = "center"}

P <- fit$W
k <- ncol(P)

mut <- c("C > A","C > G","C > T","T > A","T > C","T > G")
sub = rep(mut, each = 16)

dat1 = data.frame(m = factor(rownames(V), levels = unique(rownames(V))), sub = sub, S = P)
data2 = reshape(dat1, varying = colnames(dat1)[-c(1,2)], direction = "long", v.names = "max")
data2$time <- factor(data2$time)

data2$sub  <- factor(data2$sub, levels = names(sub_cols))
sig_levels <- levels(data2$time)

ylim_df <- data2 %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ytop  = ymax * 1.05,
         label = paste("Signature", time))

grid_df <- ylim_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(yb = list({
    rng <- c(-0.05 * ymax, 1.05 * ymax)
    equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2)(rng)
  })) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(yb) %>%
  ungroup()

panel_df <- expand.grid(sub  = factor(names(sub_cols), levels = names(sub_cols)),
                        time = factor(sig_levels, levels = sig_levels))

label_df <- ylim_df %>%
  mutate(sub = factor("T > G", levels = names(sub_cols)),
         m   = levels(data2$m)[length(levels(data2$m))])




g1 <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = m, y = max)) +
  geom_rect(data = panel_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(fill = sub),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bg_cols_gray) +
  geom_hline(data = grid_df, aes(yintercept = yb),
             colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  new_scale_fill() +                                   # <- ny fill-skala til søjlerne
  geom_bar(aes(fill = sub), stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +   # <- fill efter mutationstype
  scale_fill_manual(values = sub_cols) +               # <- søjlefarverne
  geom_text(data = label_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = m, y = ytop, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(time), cols = vars(sub),
             scales = "free", switch = "x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "line"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  ylab("Probability") + xlab("Mutation types") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0))
g1

ggsave("Output/NMF_signatures_Lung_A.pdf", plot = g1, width = 7, height = 6)

```

```{r, warning = F}

dev1 = sampleSFS(P = fit$W, E = fit$H, maxIter = 10^5, beta = 0.5, check = 1000)

prob.max = dev1$Pmaximum
```

# COSMIC data

```{r, warning = F, message = F}

COSMIC <- read_tsv("Data/COSMIC_v3.2_SBS_GRCh37.tsv")

COSMIC_matrix <- COSMIC %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = colnames(COSMIC)[1])

X <- as.matrix(COSMIC_matrix)

rn <- rownames(X)

# Udtræk substitutionen (fx "C>A") og 5'/3'-baserne
sub_type <- gsub(".*\\[(.*)\\].*", "\\1", rn)
left_base  <- substr(rn, 1, 1)
right_base <- substr(rn, nchar(rn), nchar(rn))

# Ønsket rækkefølge af substitutioner og baser
sub_order  <- c("C>A", "C>G", "C>T", "T>A", "T>C", "T>G")
base_order <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")

ord <- order(
  match(sub_type, sub_order),
  match(left_base, base_order),
  match(right_base, base_order)
)

X_sorted <- X[ord, , drop = FALSE]

```

```{r, warning = F, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 7, fig.align = "center"}

# 1. Vælg de COSMIC-signaturer du vil plotte
valgte_sigs <- c("SBS4", "SBS18", "SBS5", "SBS2", "SBS3", "SBS6", "SBS40", "SBS1", "SBS8", "SBS13") # Ret til dine ønskede signaturer
P_cosmic <- X[, valgte_sigs, drop = FALSE]

# 2. Sikr at rækkefølgen på rækkerne matcher dine mutationstyper (16 af hver i rækkefølge)
# Udtrækker f.eks. "C>A" fra "A[C>A]A" og laver mellemrum ("C > A") så det matcher din kode
raw_sub <- gsub(".*\\[(.*)\\].*", "\\1", rownames(P_cosmic))
formatted_sub <- gsub(">", " > ", raw_sub)

# Sorter data så det følger rækkefølgen i names(sub_cols) (C > A, C > G, osv.)
ord <- order(factor(formatted_sub, levels = names(sub_cols)), rownames(P_cosmic))
P_cosmic <- P_cosmic[ord, , drop = FALSE]
formatted_sub <- formatted_sub[ord]

# 3. Klargør data til ggplot (bevarer de rigtige SBS-navne)
data2 <- as.data.frame(P_cosmic) %>%
  mutate(
    m = factor(rownames(P_cosmic), levels = unique(rownames(P_cosmic))),
    sub = factor(formatted_sub, levels = names(sub_cols))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(valgte_sigs),
    names_to = "sig",
    values_to = "max"
  ) %>%
  mutate(sig = factor(sig, levels = valgte_sigs))

# 4. Hjælpe-dataframes til y-aksen, gitterlinjer, baggrund og labels
ylim_df <- data2 %>%
  group_by(sig) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(max, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    ytop  = ymax * 1.05,
    label = as.character(sig) # Viser nu "SBS1", "SBS2" osv. i stedet for "Signature 1"
  )

grid_df <- ylim_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(yb = list({
    rng <- c(-0.05 * ymax, 1.05 * ymax)
    equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2)(rng)
  })) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(yb) %>%
  ungroup()

panel_df <- expand.grid(
  sub = factor(names(sub_cols), levels = names(sub_cols)),
  sig = factor(valgte_sigs, levels = valgte_sigs)
)

label_df <- ylim_df %>%
  mutate(
    sub = factor("T > G", levels = names(sub_cols)),
    m   = levels(data2$m)[length(levels(data2$m))]
  )

g_cosmic <- ggplot(data2, aes(x = m, y = max)) +
  geom_rect(data = panel_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(fill = sub),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = bg_cols_gray) +
  geom_hline(data = grid_df, aes(yintercept = yb),
             colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  new_scale_fill() +                                          # <- ny fill-skala til søjlerne
  geom_bar(aes(fill = sub), stat = "identity", width = 0.5) + # <- fill efter mutationstype
  scale_fill_manual(values = sub_cols) +                      # <- søjlefarverne
  geom_text(data = label_df, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            aes(x = m, y = ytop, label = label),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 1.4, fontface = "bold", size = 3.2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(sig), cols = vars(sub),
             scales = "free", switch = "x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0, "line"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.4, "line"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  ylab("Probability") + xlab("Mutation types") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     breaks = equal_breaks(n = 3, s = 0.2),
                     expand = c(0.05, 0))

g_cosmic

ggsave(filename = "Output/COSMIC_signatures.pdf", plot = g_cosmic, width = 7, height = 7)


```

## Match with signatures from COSMIC

### KL-NMF

```{r}

W <- fit$W

match_nmf <- signature.match(X_sorted,W)

oversigt <- data.frame(
  signature = seq_along(match_nmf$best_match),
  matches  = sapply(match_nmf$above_tol, function(d) {
    if (is.null(d)) return(NA_character_)
    d <- d[order(-d$cosine_sim), ]
    paste0(d$cosmic_name, " (", round(d$cosine_sim, 3), ")", collapse = ", ")
  })
)

knitr::kable(oversigt,
             row.names = FALSE,
             col.names = c("Signature", "COSMIC matches (cosine similarity)"),
             align = c("c", "l"))

```
